note: PKO Bank Polski's Przejrzysta (transparent) credit card: a variable 14.50% a year, the NBP reference rate plus 12 points, held at the legal maximum since 5 March 2026 (the bank's rate table in force from 7 September 2026). Its yearly fee is 80 zlotys, 40 on 6,000 zlotys of spending in the year and none on 7,200; the middle step isn't written, so the fee is charged in full below 7,200. The optional credit insurance is not written.
